description.value:
During Vaxillus' first turn, he has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. In addition to this, any hit he scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

Vaxillus shoots first, when he is able.

If Vaxillus is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

Vaxillus is frustratingly quick, able to turn hits into near misses.

When Vaxillus rolls a ranged weapon attack with advantage, roll two additional d20s instead of one.

Vaxillus proves he is worryingly accurate with his crossbow.

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed back 5 feet.

Vaxillus attacks with the butt of his crossbow, creating some space between himself and his foe.

Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

This weapon deals an additional 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a critical hit.

Vaxillus' favorite crossbow. He has clumsily carved "Quarrelsome Bitch" into the oaken handle.

Vaxillus gives a verbal command to one or both of his wretched hounds. As long as they can hear him, they will follow that command to the best of their ability.

  • Attack. Wretched hounds make one attack attack on the chosen target. They can lunge up to 10 feet in any direction before making this attack.
  • Harry. Wretched Hounds harrass, nip at, and distract a target.  The hounds can move up to 10 feet as part of this command. Until the end of Vax's next turn, the target has disadvantage on all actions as long as they are adjacent to the hounds, and Vax's next attack has advantage and deals an additional 6d6 Piercing damage. 
  • Pin. The hounds attack the target, instead of dealing damage on a hit the creature becomes grappled, or restrained if both hounds successfully bite the target. Attempts to escape deal the hound's bite damage to the creature. They can move up to 15 feet before making these attack.
  • Seek. The hounds make a single Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage as the pair of them work together to detect and point out hidden enemies, tracks, and ambushes. If Vaxillus only has one hound, this roll does not have advantage.

Vaxillus commands his hounds to carry out an action.

Thanks to his mother, Vaxillus has been permanently bonded with the undead husks of his once beloved hounds (Medium sized Dire Wolves). These hounds are always aware of the direction and distance to Vaxillus as long as they are on the same plane as him.

Once per day Vaxillus can restore his wretched hounds to life if they were previously killed. This require half an hour of work, and the corpse of a shadow beast of medium or large size for them to crawl out of.

Vaxillus is always accompanied by two ugly, undead hounds half rotted out of their own skin.
Vaxillus does not suffer disadvantage when firing on prone targets.

Instilled with special properties by its crafter, made from wood taken from the Shadeward Manor. Its grip is engraved with the letters "Fatal Surprise".

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

This armor consists of several layers of supple leather, woven together to form highly protective but flexible armor. Minor magical enchantments grant it improved resilience as well. To support a lone hunter this armor has a quick access potion holster.

While wearing this studded leather armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. The armor includes a quick access holster which can hold a single potion that can be drank with a bonus action.
